name: Notion
headline: Easy: a connection set to 'Any workspace' installs anywhere with no review. The optional Marketplace takes 5-10 business days.

firstTest.text: About 5 minutes to a working sign-in. New accounts must finish onboarding first, or Create stays greyed out with no message.

production.text: Same day. Our OAuth connection was public and installable in any workspace from creation; sign-in needed no listing or review. Marketplace is optional.

approvalWait.text: None to install a public connection; our sign-in worked in minutes. Marketplace: an email reply in 5-10 business days plus a security review.

whoCanRegister.text: Any Notion user with a workspace can create one. Creating means accepting Notion's Developer Terms. No website or privacy policy needed.

testMode.text: No test mode: the connection is live for any workspace. Our sign-in gave an access token with no stated lifetime, plus a refresh token.

steps.title: Open the developer portal
steps.detail: Go to Profile, then Integrations, which now opens Developer tools > Connections. Integrations are now called connections; the page also lists Workers, personal access tokens and MCP tokens.

steps.title: Choose OAuth and Any workspace
steps.detail: Choose OAuth, not API token: an API token covers 1 workspace and can't go on the Marketplace. With OAuth, 'Installable in' defaults to Any workspace.

steps.title: Skip the organization fields
steps.detail: Third-party guides say the form asks for a website, privacy policy, terms and support email, but ours only needed a name, auth method, install scope and redirect addresses. Expect those fields for a Marketplace listing instead.

steps.title: Add the redirect address
steps.detail: In the OAuth domain & URIs section, add your callback address. Notion lists it as required for a public connection.

steps.title: Choose capabilities
steps.detail: After you create the connection, its page lists content (read, update, insert; all on by default), comments (off by default) and user info (default: including email). Changes save on their own.

steps.title: Copy the client ID and secret
steps.detail: Open the Configuration tab and copy both. Store the secret on your server.

steps.title: Build the sign-in flow
steps.detail: Send users to Notion's authorize page as the user, then swap the one-time code for tokens using your client ID and secret. Our exchange returned an access token and a refresh token.

steps.title: Handle the page picker
steps.detail: Users choose pages on the consent screen. Top-level pages are pre-ticked, and 'People' appears when you ask for user info. Our test shared 3 pages or databases.

steps.title: List on the Marketplace (optional)
steps.detail: You need Any workspace scope and a listing with name, description, category, tags, images and logo. Notion reviews every submission and replies by email in 5-10 business days.

blockers.title: The connection was created as 'Selected workspaces only'
blockers.fix: You can't change the scope later. Create a new connection with Any workspace.

blockers.title: Your agent sees no pages
blockers.fix: Notion only gives access to pages the user picks in the page picker. Ask users to share more pages, or offer a template to duplicate.

blockers.title: Create connection is greyed out
blockers.fix: This happens on a new account with no workspace yet, and the form gives no reason. Finish Notion's onboarding to create a workspace, then try again.

blockers.title: Your Marketplace listing is rejected
blockers.fix: Notion emails the reason. Update the listing and resubmit; the connection must be public with Any workspace scope.

blockers.title: The access token stops working
blockers.fix: A refresh flow returns a new access token and refresh token. The docs we read give no lifetimes, so refresh on a 401 error and save both new tokens each time.

agentCan: Write the sign-in flow and token refresh
Choose the minimum capability set from the actions the agent needs
Build the page-picker handling and 'share more pages' prompt
Draft the privacy policy and listing copy
Prepare the Marketplace listing assets list
youDo: Create the connection while signed in to Notion
Publish a privacy policy, terms page and support email
Copy the client secret into your secrets store
Submit the Marketplace listing if you want one
Your customers pick the pages to share

drafts.title: Connection description
drafts.body: [Product] connects your AI assistant to the Notion pages you choose. It can read, and when you ask, update or add pages. It never sees pages you don't share.

drafts.title: Marketplace listing blurb
drafts.body: Ask [Product] about your Notion workspace and have it take notes and create pages for you. You pick the pages it can reach. Remove access any time in Notion settings.

drafts.title: Support email auto-reply
drafts.body: Thanks for writing to [Product] support. We reply within [N] business days. If your agent can't see a page, open it in Notion, choose Add connections, and select [Product].

unconfirmed: Answered by our test: the creation form enforced no organization fields (no website, privacy policy, terms or support email). Whether a Marketplace listing asks for them was not tested.
Answered by our test: no review gates a public connection. The Authorization URL was shown as soon as the connection was created, and our sign-in worked minutes later.
Still open: how long tokens live. Our sign-in returned a refresh token but no stated lifetime for the access token, and the docs give no durations.
